title: Test-case reducers are underappreciated debugging tools
summary: Laurie Tratt's blog post explores test-case reducers (like C-Reduce, Delta) as powerful yet often overlooked debugging tools that automatically minimize failing test cases to their simplest form, making bugs easier to isolate and understand.
problem_solved: It solves the problem of debugging complex test cases where the essential bug is hidden among thousands of lines of irrelevant code
why_valuable: It dramatically reduces debugging time by automatically stripping away all code not essential to reproducing a bug
